units.source_text: 匂亲王想不让二女公子看见他今夜去入赘，怕她看见了心中难过。

en.t: Prince Niou did not want the Second Princess to see him go that night to enter his new marriage, fearing that the sight would distress her.

units.source_text: 所以原定从宫中直接赴六条院，只是给她写了一封信去通知一下。

en.t: So he had originally planned to go straight from the palace to Rokujo-in, merely writing her a letter to let her know.

units.source_text: 但又非常可怜二女公子，不知她的回信中怎么说，所以又悄悄地回到二条院来。

en.t: But then he felt very sorry for the Second Princess and wondered what her reply would say, so he quietly returned to Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 他看见二女公子姿色非常可爱，不忍抛舍了她而赴六条院去。

en.t: When he saw how very lovely the Second Princess looked, he could not bear to leave her behind and go to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 知道她心情不快，对她说了许多誓不变心的话。

en.t: Knowing that she was unhappy, he said many things to her, swearing that his heart would never change.

units.source_text: 明知“不能慰我情”，也和她一同到窗前观赏月色。

en.t: Although he knew that it could not comfort his feelings, he still went with her to the window to admire the moonlight.
The Captain came just at that moment.
